description: Classifies where a lead sits in the Floras GTM hierarchy so research and pitching match buyer vs supplier vs financial product issuer roles.

hierarchy_levels.brand_buyer: Large enterprise that purchases goods/services from many suppliers and accumulates Floras in a wallet.
hierarchy_levels.supplier: B2B vendor that sells into enterprise supply chains and can embed Floras to differentiate.
hierarchy_levels.financial_issuer: Bank, fintech, or lender that issues cards, loans, or payment products.
hierarchy_levels.poor_fit: Entity with weak transaction-embed surface (e.g. pure asset manager, holding company).
hierarchy_levels.dual_role: Operates as both a significant buyer and a supplier to other enterprises.

entity_types.label: Enterprise buyer
entity_types.summary: Accumulates Floras from procurement and supplier-integrated transactions into an enterprise wallet.
entity_types.pitch_focus: Wallet, Scope 3 procurement, supplier engagement, certificates from purchasing activity.
entity_types.outreach_target: Chief Procurement Officer, Head of Sustainability, Supply Chain Director
entity_types.tavily_query_focus: suppliers procurement supply chain scope 3 sustainability program ESG commitments

entity_types.label: Supplier to enterprises
entity_types.summary: Embeds Floras into products or invoices to win and retain enterprise buyers — supplier differentiation, not buyer wallet accumulation.
entity_types.pitch_focus: Win enterprise accounts by embedding Floras; help buyers meet Scope 3 goals through your transactions.
entity_types.outreach_target: Sales Director, Key Account Manager, Head of Sustainability, Commercial leadership
entity_types.tavily_query_focus: B2B customers enterprise clients supplier packaging ingredients manufacturer sustainability
entity_types.pitch_note: Do NOT pitch enterprise wallet accumulation as if this company is Pepsi. Pitch supplier-side Floras embed to help their enterprise customers.

entity_types.label: Financial product issuer
entity_types.summary: Issues cards, loans, or payment products where Floras can embed as a climate-linked product feature.
entity_types.pitch_focus: Product differentiation on cards, lending, or payments — not supply-chain procurement.
entity_types.outreach_target: Head of Cards, Loan Product Manager, Head of Sustainable Finance, Innovation Lead
entity_types.tavily_query_focus: credit card rewards green loan sustainable finance products ESG banking

entity_types.label: Poor fit / wrong entity type
entity_types.summary: Weak Floras transaction-embed surface — e.g. pure asset manager, advisory-only financial firm, or holding company without procurement leverage.
entity_types.pitch_focus: Deprioritize unless a narrow sub-use-case is evidenced (travel, specific product line).
entity_types.outreach_target: Only pursue if research surfaces a specific exception; otherwise deprioritize.
entity_types.tavily_query_focus: business model services asset management investment bank AUM sustainability financed emissions
entity_types.fit_cap_note: Default fit should be Low unless research shows a clear exception (corporate travel, card products, green lending).

entity_types.label: Dual role: buyer and supplier
entity_types.summary: Both purchases at scale from suppliers AND sells B2B into other enterprises — two valid Floras angles; clarify which side BD is targeting first.
entity_types.pitch_focus: Separate buyer-wallet story from supplier-embed story; BD often targets supplier outreach first.
entity_types.outreach_target: Clarify: supplier commercial team vs procurement/sustainability — suppliers-first GTM may apply.
entity_types.tavily_query_focus: suppliers customers procurement B2B supply chain scope 3 sustainability
entity_types.pitch_note: Acknowledge dual role. If BD targets suppliers first, lead with supplier-embed differentiation; note buyer-wallet opportunity separately.

preview_uses: text_signals from notes and company name only
